DataWorld-Train-2k-part1

Zhanli-Li/DataWorld-Train-2k-part1

Analyse a synthetic world's data files in a sandbox and write a report on causes or consequences to /app/answer.txt, scored by a rubric judge.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • RL on causal data analysis
  • long-horizon agentic data work

Reward

How it is scored
Rubric
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Judge-scored rubric, mapped to reward = 100 * (raw - lo) / (hi - lo) in [0, 100].

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download Zhanli-Li/DataWorld-Train-2k-part1 --repo-type dataset --local-dir DataWorld-Train-2k-part1

2. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zhanli-Li/DataWorld-Train-2k-part1 --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Docker; judge credentials in tests/judge.env; 8 CPUs, 16 GB memory.
